verdict.rationale: Polar's official remote MCP server lets agents "take actions across your products" and more, backed by typed SDKs, versioned OpenAPI specs, and a Checkout Session API for API-driven checkout, all testable in an isolated sandbox. So an agent can plausibly create a product and start checkout in one session. However, the evidence never explicitly documents creating products or prices via the API, and Checkout Links are described as configured in the dashboard rather than created programmatically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of product/price creation endpoints, documented API creation of shareable payment/checkout links, any hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the full product→price→link flow.
